programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save the Marooned Mayors; Pups Save the Game Show
programs.desc: While ice fishing in the North Country, Mayor Goodway and Mayor Humdinger get stuck in an ice crevasse; Beryl hosts a game show at the Wingnuts' farm.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Air Rescue: Pups Stop a Rocket-Powered Pogo Stick; Air Rescue: Pups Save the Sky-High Stunt Show
programs.desc: Danny's rocket-boosted pogo stick accidentally causes a fire; it's up to the entire Air Rescue team to save Danny and stop the forest from going up in flames; when Francois' big stunt show goes horribly awry, the Air Rescue pups are on a roll.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Mighty Pups, Charged Up: Mighty Pups Versus the Copycat
programs.desc: The Mighty Pups get charged up to take on new superbaddie the Copycat; it will take all-new powers and gear to take down their most formidable foe to date.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.desc: When Mayor Humdinger transforms his robot cat Meow-Meow into a tiger-sized metal-eating menace, the PAW Patrol calls in the Cat Pack for help with stopping the creature.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Sea Patrol: Pups Save a Water Walker; Sea Patrol: Pups Save a Windsurfer
programs.desc: Mayor Humdinger swipes Francois' water-walking shoes and ends up trapped in a pit-like turtle nest; the pups spring into action when a nearby volcano erupts.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Cat Pack/PAW Patrol Rescue: Rocket Rescuers; Cat Pack/PAW Patrol Rescue: The Golden Lion Mask
programs.desc: Cat-Pack members Wild and Shade team up with the Mighty Pups to stop a runaway rocket; when the Ruff-Ruff Pack swipes a priceless golden lion mask from the museum, Shade and Wild must help the PAW Patrol to retrieve the stolen artifact.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Moto Pups: Pups vs. the Ruff-Ruff Pack
programs.desc: Stunt motorcyclist Wild Cat joins the patrol to try to keep Ruff-Ruff Pack troublemakers from trashing the town.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save a Humdinger Doll; Pups Save a Sand Sculpture Contest
programs.desc: The PAW Patrol must rescue Mayor Humdinger; Mayor Humdinger tries to cheat at the Adventure Bay sand sculpture contest.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save the Tooth Fairy; Pups Solve the Mystery of the Missing Art
programs.desc: Julius loses his tooth and has a dream that the PAW Patrol saves a bumbling tooth fairy; when all the paintings mysteriously disappear from the Art Museum Festival, the PAW Patrol must solve the missing art mystery and return all the paintings.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Mighty Pups, Super Paws: Pups Save a Giant Chicken; Mighty Pups, Super Paws: Pups Stop Harold's Deep Freeze
programs.desc: The Mighty Twins join the Mighty Pups to save a giant chicken and the town; the Mighty Pups have to stop Harold Humdinger before he puts Adventure Bay in a deep freeze so he can become mayor.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Mighty Pups, Super Paws: When Super Kitties Attack
programs.desc: When the Kitty Catastrophe crew gets superpowers, the little kittens cause big problems all over town.

programs.title: Sonic Prime
programs.desc: To get help in the fight against Nine and his winged lackeys, Sonic heads to New Yoke and forms an allegiance with the very last people he ever expected.
